name: growth-desk
description: Growth Desk: plan, make, approve, publish, measure and sell, for every Humini product.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @growth-desk/contract && concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @growth-desk/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @growth-desk/api" "npm run dev -w @growth-desk/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @growth-desk/contract && npm run build -w @growth-desk/api && npm run build -w @growth-desk/web --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @growth-desk/contract && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test -w @growth-desk/contract && npm run test -w @growth-desk/api && npm run test -w @growth-desk/web --if-present
scripts.docker:infra: docker compose up -d postgres minio minio-init
